user.title: Add a Xiaomi MIoT BLE device
user.description: Select a nearby device. Enter a 12-byte BLE token manually, or leave it empty to reuse a locally stored key or retrieve it from Xiaomi Cloud.

cloud_auth.title: Retrieve the BLE key from Xiaomi Cloud
cloud_auth.description: Sign in to retrieve the BLE key for {name}. The credentials are used only for this request and are not stored in Home Assistant.

cloud_captcha.title: Complete Xiaomi Cloud captcha
cloud_captcha.description:
Enter the text shown below to continue retrieving the BLE key for {name}.

![Xiaomi captcha]({captcha_image})

cloud_verify.title: Complete Xiaomi account verification
cloud_verify.description: [Open the Xiaomi verification page]({verification_url}), complete the phone or email check, then enter the verification ticket to continue retrieving the BLE key for {name}.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the BLE token
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a new 12-byte BLE token for {name}.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the device
error.invalid_token: The token must contain 24 hexadecimal characters
error.cloud_invalid_auth: Xiaomi Cloud rejected the account credentials
error.cloud_invalid_captcha: Xiaomi Cloud rejected the captcha; try the refreshed image
error.cloud_invalid_verification: Xiaomi Cloud rejected the verification ticket
error.cloud_device_not_found: The Bluetooth device was not found in this Xiaomi account
error.cloud_key_unsupported: Xiaomi Cloud returned a key that is not a 12-byte BLE token

abort.not_supported: The discovered Bluetooth device is not supported
abort.missing_setup_data: Device setup information expired; start the flow again
abort.missing_cloud_challenge: Xiaomi Cloud verification expired; start the flow again
